title: Fine Fishing
description:
Oh, hey, didn't see you there. Who am I? Oh, I'm nobody special. Just your average fisherman, I suppose. But enough about me, what's got you here?
You here to fish as well? Well, that's great! I'll gladly teach you, if you're up for it. Just get yourself a fishing rod and we can begin. Sorry I don't have a spare, but they are pretty cheap, just some sticks and string. Or rocks, if you want that for some reason.
